tools.name: axveritas_preflight_check
tools.description: Pre-flight URL dead-end check (1 preflight credit or $0.005 USDC). Returns PASSABLE or DEAD_END with a category and reason: blocked (WAF/403/429), broken (4xx/5xx), timeout, js_shell (needs a browser), soft_block (CAPTCHA page served as 200), soft_404. Call before fetching any external URL.

tools.name: axveritas_scrape_verified
tools.description: Schema-verified web extraction (1 scrape credit or $0.02 USDC). Returns clean JSON (url, title, description, headings, links, text) with an ABVS-1.0 SHA-256 receipt; fails if any required_keys are missing or empty.

tools.name: axveritas_usage
tools.description: Free (no credits): show remaining credits and your savings so far — dead ends avoided and estimated tokens saved.

tools.name: axveritas_relay_create
tools.description: Hire another agent (a 'worker') safely: Axveritas calls the worker's endpoint, checks its JSON output has the required fields and at least the minimum number of records, and only then lets you have it. Fee: 1% of bounty_usdc ($0.005 minimum, 1 credit with an API key). Without worker_wallet the verif

tools.name: axveritas_relay_release
tools.description: Settlement mode, final step: after paying the worker in USDC on Base, submit the job_id, release_token and the payment transaction hash. Axveritas checks on-chain that the right amount reached the worker's wallet in time, then returns the verified output (check it against payload_hash). Calling agai

tools.name: axveritas_relay_status
tools.description: Free: check a relay job's status (AWAITING_PAYMENT, RELEASED or EXPIRED), payment instructions and deadline. Does not return the data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "axveritas_relay_create" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "axveritas_relay_create" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: axveritas_preflight_check, axveritas_scrape_verified · Private data: axveritas_usage, axveritas_relay_create, axveritas_relay_release · Public sink: axveritas_relay_create, axveritas_relay_release.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: axveritas_preflight_check, axveritas_scrape_verified · Private data: axveritas_usage, axveritas_relay_create, axveritas_relay_release · Public sink: axveritas_relay_create, axveritas_relay_release

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
